title: Static + Animated Logotype
summary: Threads is a contemporary clothing retail brand targeting young, fashion conscious shoppers and local trendsetters.

overview.solution: Rather than treating the name as purely metaphorical, the concept centers on the physical behavior of thread itself, how it loops, pulls, overlaps, and binds garments together.
